spanish: Y harás el candelabro de oro puro; a martillo será hecho el candelabro; su muslo y su caña, sus cálices, sus bulbos y sus flores, desde él serán.
grammarChanges: menorá -> el candelabro: supplied the Spanish common noun with its required article for H4501 (both occurrences, h02025031002 and h02025031007).
hecha -> hecho: verb agreement changed from feminine to masculine because the Spanish noun candelabro is masculine.
ella -> él: pronoun agreement changed from feminine to masculine for the same reason.
de martillo -> a martillo: changed the preposition so H4749 reads as manner/method, not as a material parallel to 'de oro'.
manzanas -> bulbos: replaced the fruit sense with a non-fruit Spanish noun for the architectural knob named by H3730.
readerNote: Translating menorá as the masculine noun candelabro required changing the following verb (hecho) and pronoun (él) from feminine to masculine to keep Spanish agreement.
